violations.text: Recently cooked chicken was observed held at 43-50 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed container in freezer to rapidly chill. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of staff, chicken was placed hot in the prep in containers greater than four inches deep. Cooling methods reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026

A bucket of potatoes was observed stored on the floor in the kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Staff placed bucket on a riser during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -under grill tops -refrigerator gaskets -slicer (cleaned during inspection). New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

The floors and walls behind the cookline have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. PIC stated hoods are scheduled for cleaning today; floors and walls to be cleaned after service. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

Sausage was observed held at 48 degrees Fahrenheit above the fill line in the prep unit; a plate of sausage was observed held at 64 degrees and placed over the fill line in prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Staff placed sausage above fill line in alternate refrigeration, plate of sausage was placed in refrigerator to rapidly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

Working containers of water, oil, and sauces are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -under grill tops -bottom shelving of prep units -rack under table. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2025
Trash and leaf debris was observed in the shared refuse receptacle area. Refuse areas shall be maintained free of debris to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2025
